issues.desc: background.md uses step numbers 3.2/3.3/3.4/3.5 and the label forward-A/B-proof multiple times (Trigger Event and Conversational Texture sections), but never defines within the background text what program sequence these numbers belong to or what forward-A/B-proof means. The only pointer is an external file path (lattice-Paper/experience-forward-ab-proof-design.md outside the repo), so a new reader cannot independently understand the numbering scope or the proof-design constraints from the background alone. Standalone readability is mildly degraded.
